scope: Gibraltar, empty-handed (movescale 1.15), flat test platform, 144 fps (dt ~ 0.00696 s, 1 usercmd per frame). Sessions 20261020_205712_M2_rerun and 20261020_204723_M2_main, ok=true, warmup=false trials only (42 trials, 118 jumps). Produced by air_jump_analysis.py; full numbers in results.json / analysis_output.txt.
units: Source units (u), seconds (s); dt = usercmd frametime from the joined HSD frame (ft).

gravity.source: census sv_gravity 750 x gravityScale 1; fitted per airborne usercmd (vz - pvz)/dt

spread.note: spread is print quantisation (%.3f) over dt ~ 0.007 s

vertical_integration.source: fitted: dz residual rms 0.00065 u (max 0.00217) vs 0.0184 u for explicit or semi-implicit Euler, n=10054
vertical_integration.formula: vz -= g*dt/2; z += vz*dt; vz -= g*dt/2   (== z += (vz_pre+vz_post)/2*dt)

horizontal_integration.source: fitted: dxy residual rms 0.00112 u (post v) vs 0.0332 u (pre v), n=10054

jump_height.formula: V = sqrt(2*g*jumpHeight*frac); frac = 1 for an unpenalised jump

jump_speed_V.source: derived sqrt(2*750*56); fitted from post vz of the jump command + 1.5*g*dt
jump_speed_V.formula: jump command: vz = -g*dt/2 (start gravity) + V; vz -= g*dt/2 (FinishGravity inside the jump); z += vz*dt; vz -= g*dt/2  =>  displacement uses V - g*dt, post vz = V - 1.5*g*dt (~282.0 at 144 fps)

jump_post_vz_144fps.source: observed post vz of the jump command (first jumps)
jump_post_vz_144fps.formula: V - 1.5*g*dt; the next command's post vz (~276.8) is V - 2.5*g*dt

apex_height.source: observed max post z - take-off z, unpenalised jumps with no correction
apex_height.formula: continuous half-step apex = V^2/(2g) - V*dt/2 + g*dt^2/8 = 54.996 at dt 0.00695; sampled max is <= that

air_time.source: observed jump command .. landing command inclusive, flat ground, unpenalised

commands.note: landing command index minus jump command index

air_time.formula: emerges from V, half-step gravity and the 2 u ground probe; simulation reproduces the landing command index exactly in 112/113 jumps (off by 1 in 1)

ground_probe.source: Source CategorizePosition convention (not a census key); consistent with observed landing-command heights above floor 0.255..1.982 (n=118)
ground_probe.formula: falling (vz<0) and floor within 2 u below -> grounded, vz=0 at the end of that command; next command snaps down onto the floor

antiMultiJumpHeightFrac.source: census antiMultiJumpHeightFrac 0.3; fitted plateau 0.29998 (sd 0.00002, n=14, jumps < 0.05 s after landing)
antiMultiJumpHeightFrac.formula: frac(t) = clamp(0.3 + 0.7*(t - t0)/T, 0.3, 1); V = sqrt(2*g*jumpHeight*frac); t = time since the last landing

multiJumpPenalty_hold_t0.source: fitted (not a census key): linear fit of height frac vs dedi event clock JUMP.t - TOUCH_GROUND.t
multiJumpPenalty_hold_t0.formula: penalty stays at 0.3 for t <= 0.15 s

multiJumpPenalty_ramp_T.source: fitted (not a census key): same fit; full height at t0+T = 0.75 s
multiJumpPenalty_ramp_T.validation: independent: 5 server-only penalised stand jumps (dedi treats the [HSD-RESET] teleport as a landing) predicted to within 0.0001 frac; 3 stand jumps at 0.767-0.793 s predicted unpenalised, observed unpenalised
multiJumpPenalty_ramp_T.formula: linear in height (not in V): on the dedi clock height-frac linear rms 0.00002 vs V/V0-linear rms 0.0051

airAcceleration.unit: u/s^2 (applied as accelspeed = A*dt, no wishspeed factor)
airAcceleration.source: census airAcceleration 500; fitted a/dt on unclipped strafe commands
airAcceleration.formula: AirAccelerate: wishcap = min(wishspeed, airSpeed*movescale); add = wishcap - dot(v_xy, wishdir); if add <= 0 return; v_xy += min(A*dt, add)*wishdir

air_wishspeed_cap.source: census airSpeed 60 x movescale 1.15; fitted bracket from add-speed-limited strafe commands [69.000, 69.000]
air_wishspeed_cap.formula: cap = airSpeed * movescale (airSpeed alone: residual rms 0.279, max 3.56 u/s per command)

air_wishdir_yaw.value: yaw of the frame that shows the command's post-state
air_wishdir_yaw.source: fitted: previous-frame yaw gives residual rms 0.207 / max 3.50 vs 0.0039 / 0.0142
air_wishdir_yaw.formula: forward=(cos yaw, sin yaw), right=(sin yaw, -cos yaw); wishvel = fwd*forward + side*right; wishspeed = min(|wishvel|,1)*maxspeed (maxspeed airborne = speed 173.5 * 1.15 = 199.525)

airFriction.source: census airFriction 0; no-input horizontal speed change 0.0000 u/s per command (n=524)

jump_command_friction.source: observed: horizontal speed change on the jump command 0.003 u/s (sd 0.013, n=118) incl. hop0 jumps 1 command after landing
jump_command_friction.formula: jump command: no ground friction; ground speed clamp (sprint 299) still applies

skip_speed_reduce.source: not observed: no horizontal loss at take-off for ground times 0.007-0.60 s at 295-299 u/s (n=76 re-jumps); stock 100 per phase-1 notes

landSlowdownDuration.source: census landSlowdownDuration 1; not observed: landing command speed change +0.005 u/s (n=76), maxspeed unchanged after landing (landing |vz| <= ~282)

air_input_residual_gain.source: fitted, unexplained: with W held above the cap, horizontal speed still rises ~k*vz^2 (rms 0.088 u/s^2 vs 0.30 for a constant); total +0.301 u/s per full jump (n=5)
air_input_residual_gain.formula: ignored in the model (0.1 % of speed)

lurch_single_condition.source: observed only in e2_strafe (5/5 identical, dedi identical): +moveright press edge 5 commands after a 299 u/s jump, sidemove 0.5 on that command, wish 90.7 deg off velocity
lurch_single_condition.formula: unknown in general (needs E3); see AIR-JUMP-MODEL.md section 5
